purpose: Close the frozen formal runner's CLI artifact-substitution gap without changing the runner, source lock, inputs, candidate, assessor, thresholds, budgets, ABBA order, numerical mechanism or public product surface.

checker.role: Run as a separate pre-run or post-run process. It is forbidden to wrap, parent or replace the frozen formal runner.

governing_interpretation.existing_rule: The frozen protocol already requires exact source/input hashes, zero input_or_source_hash_mismatch_count, exact source-lock provenance and publication only after source, input, process-isolation and host audits pass.
governing_interpretation.defect: formal_abba.py verifies the repository copies named by development-source-lock.json but does not prove that its four CLI input paths designate those exact copies; finalize_abba.py also does not consume manifest_match or input_match from the source observer.
governing_interpretation.correction_class: Outcome-blind external fail-closed provenance enforcement only. mechanism-preregistration.json permits defect corrections that make source conform to its frozen text when recorded before any outcome is opened.
not_authorized: Changing formal_abba.py, finalize_abba.py, development-source-lock.json or any hash they freeze
Accepting an alternative path, artifact, hash, environment, runner, assessor, threshold, route, budget or ABBA sequence
Adding a wrapper between exclusive_run.py and formal_abba.py
Opening or interpreting Gold, K0, K1, safety, segment or efficacy outcomes during either binding phase
Retrying, resuming or concatenating a failed or incomplete formal run

outcome_blind_attestation.allowed_observation: File paths, byte counts, SHA-256 values, Git lineage, source-lock metadata, command tokens, process IDs, timestamps and capture topology only. Candidate/truth/K0 gzip payloads and segment traces remain unopened.

frozen_execution.clean_rule: Pre-run requires an entirely clean worktree. Post-run permits only untracked result/audit artifacts; the index and every tracked file must remain clean.
frozen_execution.lineage_rule: HEAD must equal head_commit, HEAD^ must equal source_commit, and HEAD must be the commit that introduced development-source-lock.json. A merge commit or later documentation commit is not eligible.

pre_run_requirements: The amendment and checker are committed, unmodified and match checker.sha256.
The frozen worktree is fully clean at exact HEAD 2601dce with parent 0494e65.
Every development-source-lock file and all four official input hashes match.
No bound staging, partial, official, outer, host, source, pre-binding or post-binding path exists.
No bound path or existing ancestor traverses a symlink, junction or reparse point.
The computed direct-child, exclusive and finalizer token arrays equal the exact arrays above; every formal flag occurs exactly once.
The successful pre-binding audit is atomically written only to pre_binding_audit_path before the host observer and exclusive run start.
post_run_requirements: The successful pre-binding audit, amendment, checker, HEAD, source lock, tracked files, inputs and command plan are unchanged.
The outer audit records the exact child command, cwd and label with completed outcome, exit code zero and no runner error.
capture.json binds the exact lock commit, source-lock hash, manifest hash, candidate uncompressed hash, Julia Manifest and complete fresh-process ABBA topology.
No segment trace is opened or interpreted by the binding checker.
The host observation binds all PIDs, spans the full outer interval and reports zero contention, zero lease loss, no live formal PID and no outcome inspection.
The source observation explicitly records manifest_match=true, input_match=true, zero source mismatch, no outcome inspection, and hashes of this amendment, checker and pre-binding audit.
The successful post-binding audit is atomically written once inside staging as post_binding_audit_filename before exact_finalizer_command_tokens may be executed.
terminal_stop_conditions: Any pre-run or post-run checker failure or inability to write its fixed audit path
Any path, hash, Git lineage, tracked-file, command-token, cwd, label, executable, capture, host or source-observer mismatch
Any duplicate formal flag, symlink, junction, reparse point or path alias
Any existing output path, partial run, nonzero child exit, incomplete ABBA, lease loss or host contention
Any Gold, K0, K1, safety or segment outcome inspection before the frozen assessor phase
Any attempt to repair a mismatch by editing an expected hash or rerunning a partial formal sequence
publication_rule: finalize_abba.py may be invoked only with exact_finalizer_command_tokens after a passed post-binding audit exists in staging. A passed development assessment still authorizes only result-blind locked-family preregistration, never immediate product connection.
change_rule: This amendment and checker are immutable after their joint pre-outcome commit. Any change requires a new experiment ID; expected hashes and exact command tokens are never updated to accept drift.
